description: Per-VM storage for tenants: the guest's view of every disk from libvirt, and the backend's view (Ceph RBD or Pure FlashArray) of the selected Cinder volume.

panels.description: Protocol rbd = Ceph; disk type block = iSCSI (Pure). Volume ID is empty for ephemeral disks.
panels.title: Disks

targets.expr: max by (target_device, serial, source_protocol, disk_type, driver_cache, driver_discard, target_bus, compute) (libvirt_domain_block_stats_info{os_region="$region",domain="$instance",target_device=~"$disk"})

panels.description: Requests the guest issued, as QEMU counts them; includes any QoS throttling.
panels.title: IOPS

panels.description: Time per request as the guest sees it (QEMU), including backend, network and QoS waits.
panels.title: Average latency

panels.description: Provisioned from QEMU. Used from the backend: Ceph rbd du or Pure total_physical (after data reduction), joined through the Cinder volume ID.
panels.title: Capacity

targets.expr: max by (target_device) (ceph_rbd_image_used_bytes{os_region="$region"} * on (image) group_left (uuid) label_replace(max by (uuid, backend_name) (openstack_volume_metadata{os_region="$region"}), "image", "$1", "backend_name", "(.*)") * on (uuid) group_left (target_device) label_replace(max by (serial, target_device) (libvirt_domain_block_stats_info{os_region="$region",domain="$instance",target_device=~"$disk"}), "uuid", "$1", "serial", "(.*)"))

max by (target_device) (purefa_volume_space_bytes{os_region="$region",space="total_physical"} * on (name) group_left (uuid) label_replace(max by (uuid, backend_name) (openstack_volume_metadata{os_region="$region"}), "name", "$1", "backend_name", "(.*)") * on (uuid) group_left (target_device) label_replace(max by (serial, target_device) (libvirt_domain_block_stats_info{os_region="$region",domain="$instance",target_device=~"$disk"}), "uuid", "$1", "serial", "(.*)"))
max by (display_name, volume_type, host, backend_name, uuid, project_id) (openstack_volume_metadata{os_region="$region",uuid="$volume"})

panels.description: Volume size: RBD image size (rbd du, every 5 minutes) or the Pure volume's provisioned size.
panels.title: Provisioned

panels.description: Ceph: space the image uses, snapshots excluded (rbd du, every 5 minutes). Pure: data the host has written (virtual), before data reduction.
panels.title: Used

panels.description: Used (Ceph) or written (Pure) as a share of the provisioned size.
panels.title: Used %

panels.description: Per-volume operations from the Ceph mgr prometheus module (rbd_stats_pools) or the Pure FlashArray exporter.
panels.title: IOPS

panels.description: Latency per operation as the backend sees it (librbd for Ceph, the array for Pure). Pure QoS wait is the time held back by the volume's QoS limit. Compare with the guest view above, which includes the hypervisor and the network.
panels.title: Average latency

targets.expr: max without (instance, job) (rate(ceph_rbd_read_latency_sum{cluster_name="$cluster",pool="$pool",image="$image"}[$__rate_interval])) / max without (instance, job) (rate(ceph_rbd_read_latency_count{cluster_name="$cluster",pool="$pool",image="$image"}[$__rate_interval]))

max without (instance, job) (rate(ceph_rbd_write_latency_sum{cluster_name="$cluster",pool="$pool",image="$image"}[$__rate_interval])) / max without (instance, job) (rate(ceph_rbd_write_latency_count{cluster_name="$cluster",pool="$pool",image="$image"}[$__rate_interval]))

max without (instance, job) (rate(ceph_rbd_read_bytes{cluster_name="$cluster",pool="$pool",image="$image"}[$__rate_interval])) / max without (instance, job) (rate(ceph_rbd_read_ops{cluster_name="$cluster",pool="$pool",image="$image"}[$__rate_interval]))

max without (instance, job) (rate(ceph_rbd_write_bytes{cluster_name="$cluster",pool="$pool",image="$image"}[$__rate_interval])) / max without (instance, job) (rate(ceph_rbd_write_ops{cluster_name="$cluster",pool="$pool",image="$image"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.description: Ceph: rbd du, every 5 minutes. Pure: written is before data reduction; physical is after deduplication and compression, snapshots included.
panels.title: Capacity

list.label: volume (Cinder ID)
list.name: volume
list.description: Cinder volume attached to the instance, for the backend view below.

list.label: backend
list.name: backend
list.description: Cinder backend of the selected volume, from its host (ceph@... or pure@...).
